input: Set up a memory box for the kids

keyUnknowns.whyItMatters: Whether this is one shared box for all kids or individual boxes per child completely changes the materials, organisation, and effort required.
The ages and number of children affect what items are worth keeping, how categories are structured, and how far back to go.
Whether this is a physical box, a digital archive, or both determines the entire approach, tools, and storage needed.
Available budget affects whether to buy a decorative keepsake box, repurpose something, or invest in archival materials or scanning tools.
Where the box will live (a shelf, a closet, offsite storage) affects the size, durability, and labelling system chosen.
Knowing which types of items to include — art, school reports, photos, tickets, clothing — shapes how the box is divided and what gets prioritised.
Whether the goal is a one-time setup or an ongoing system the family adds to regularly changes how much structure and process needs to be built in.

gold.taskTitle: Set up a memory box for the kids
gold.taskDescription: Create a dedicated memory box to collect and preserve meaningful keepsakes and mementos for the children.

questions.title: Is this one shared box or one per child?
questions.description: Determine whether all children share a single memory box or each child gets their own dedicated box.

questions.title: How many kids, and what are their ages?
questions.description: Establish the number of children and their age range to guide categorisation, how far back to collect items, and appropriate labelling.

questions.title: Should this be physical, digital, or both?
questions.description: Decide whether to create a physical keepsake box, a digital archive (photos, scans), or a hybrid of the two.

questions.title: What is your budget for this project?
questions.description: Clarify how much money is available to spend on boxes, archival materials, labels, scanning tools, or decorative elements.

questions.title: Where will the box be stored long-term?
questions.description: Identify the intended storage location — a bedroom shelf, loft, closet — to guide decisions on box size, material, and durability.

questions.title: What types of items are most important to keep?
questions.description: Determine the priority categories of mementos — artwork, school reports, photos, tickets, small toys, clothing — so the box is sized and organised accordingly.

questions.title: Is this a one-time sort or an ongoing system?
questions.description: Establish whether the goal is simply to gather existing keepsakes once, or to build a repeatable process the family adds to over the years.
